scalar.scope: Fixed fixtures and archived example only; no success-rate sampling or new witness claim.

planes.scope: Finite arithmetic/helper controls; no class enumeration, real online trial or complete instruction census.

mocked_interface.scope: Mock dispatcher controls, not claims about real sampled outcomes. The online mode exports a checked prefix/control pair rather than verifying full digest equality in its return branch.

sampler_branch.scope: If the upper 224 source bits were exactly uniform, modulo 65 gives (floor(2^224/65)+1)/2^224 for residue zero, not exactly 1/65. No SHAKE distribution theorem or practical impact is inferred.

scope: Pinned copied-source scalar, plane and mocked-interface fixtures. No Env construction, class/member enumeration, real sampler, attack, ledger optimization or price/success proof. The runtime report identifies tested bytes, not every function or mode in the tool.
